observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: public outdoor and indoor spaces with spectators, red carpets, and festive red lanterns during an event
observation.dancers: a group of mixed male performers manipulating a long dragon puppet, plus one person leading with a pearl-on-a-pole
observation.formation_and_space: line formation manipulating a flexible dragon puppet, moving in circles, undulating waves, and spirals across the performance space
observation.posture: athletic upright posture with bent knees and active torso engagement
observation.footwork: quick stepping and shifting weight across the beat, with runners supporting the dragon sections and performers crouching or kneeling periodically
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extended upward holding long poles attached to the dragon segments and pearl prop
observation.hips_and_torso: torso bending, twisting, and crouching as performers maneuver the dragon structure
observation.partnering: group coordination with synchronized manipulation of the dragon segments rather than physical partner contact
observation.levels_jumps_turns: levels vary between standing upright, crouching, and lifting performers onto shoulders for elevated dragon poses
observation.costume_and_props: matching red and green/yellow outfits with trousers and headbands; long flexible pink and purple lit dragon puppet with poles, and a sphere prop on a pole
observation.cannot_infer: exact individual footwork details due to wide camera angles and rapid group movement

dancers swirl the dragon in a circular looping pattern forming a ring shape
performers lift two dancers holding dragon sections onto shoulders to elevate the dragon head high
